capabilities.title: Three things start happening the moment you turn it on.

items.title: Answer before your customer goes to the competition.
items.body: Every WhatsApp message answered in seconds, 24/7 — not minutes, not hours. The customer who would have left waiting stays in the chat.

items.title: Your staff stops doing two things at once.
items.body: The bot takes the order, the booking, the question. Your team supervises and steps in only when it matters.

items.title: Run your business from anywhere.
items.body: A dashboard that shows what's selling, what customers complain about, who comes back. You see the operation without being at the counter.

starter.name: Starter
starter.tagline: One number, one location, fully on.

items.q: What does The Clam AI do, exactly?
items.a: It's an AI assistant connected to your WhatsApp Business number. It reads incoming messages in any language and responds with accurate, on-brand replies — taking orders, bookings, qualifying leads, answering FAQs, and handing off to a human when needed.

items.q: Is it just for restaurants and hotels?
items.a: No. It works for any business that talks to customers on WhatsApp — pharmacies, real estate offices, car dealerships, clinics, service companies. We tune it to your industry during onboarding.

items.q: Do I need any technical setup?
items.a: None. We do a 30-minute briefing call, you share your menu/listings/inventory/FAQs, and we configure, test, and go live for you.
It detects the customer's language automatically and replies in kind — 20+ languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Chinese, and Arabic.

items.q: What happens when the AI can't answer?
items.a: Any message it's not confident about is flagged and handed off to your team in real time. You set the rules — by topic, hours, or confidence threshold.

items.q: Can it integrate with my POS, PMS, or CRM?
items.a: Yes — on Pro and Custom plans. We integrate with most modern systems via API. If yours is unusual, talk to us about Custom.
All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We're GDPR-aligned, never sell or share data, and let you configure conversation retention per your policies.

items.q: How long does it take to go live?
items.a: Most clients are live within 72 hours of the onboarding call. Complex integrations may add a few days.

items.q: What if my customer prefers talking to a person?
items.a: The bot hands off cleanly to your team the moment the customer asks, the conversation gets sensitive, or the AI isn't confident. Your team picks up with the full conversation context — the customer never has to repeat themselves.

items.q: Do I need to change my current WhatsApp number?
items.a: No. We can attach to the number you already use. Your customers keep messaging the same number, and your team keeps seeing everything from the same WhatsApp they use today.
Yes. All plans are month-to-month. Your number stays yours and we export all data within 48 hours of cancellation.

final_cta.title: Try it now, or book a call.
final_cta.sub: The fastest way to know if it works for your business is to message the bot yourself.

items.title: "Can I see the menu?"
items.body: If they don't see prices fast, they don't come at all.
